## Install or upgrade

For an upgrade, Exit from the tray and confirm `Get-Process SmartSnippets.App,SmartSnippets,SmartSnippets.UnoCandidate -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue` prints nothing. Do not run old and new executables together. Verify `(Get-FileHash .\SmartSnippets-win-x64-<version>.zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash` matches the `.sha256` asset. Extract using `Expand-Archive .\SmartSnippets-win-x64-<version>.zip -DestinationPath "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs" -Force`, then run `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\SmartSnippets\SmartSnippets.exe` once to migrate the old Start at login entry. Remove the old `SmartSnippets.App.exe` after exiting it, and recreate any old shortcuts or taskbar pins. In Explorer **Extract All…**, explicitly choose `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs` as the destination and replace files; the default destination creates an extra folder.

The executable is unsigned, so SmartScreen may warn on first run: if you trust the verified download, choose **More info** → **Run anyway**, or unblock it in Properties. The official Uno app opens the existing profile in place. Back up that profile while all versions are closed. Existing recognized Start at login commands are normalized on ordinary launch; the old Uno candidate Run value is removed. If startup was disabled, it stays disabled. Data and logs live separately in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\SmartSnippets`. For a clean upgrade, after Exit you can delete the installation folder before extracting. To uninstall, disable Start at login, Exit, delete `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\SmartSnippets`, and optionally delete the data folder.

See the [install and release guide](https://github.com/rockyway/smartsnippets/blob/main/docs/guides/001-install-and-release.md) for details.
